description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseVectorStoreConfig' with methods related to configuring and transforming requests/responses for vector store integrations within a language modeling framework. It also includes type annotations, external imports, and some utility functions for handling vector store interactions.

classes.name: BaseVectorStoreConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class providing interfaces for vector store configuration, request transformation, response parsing, and environment validation within a language model framework.

methods.description: Transforms a search request to match the vector store's API format.
